projects.thescreamingchef.short_descript: Custom WordPress website built from scratch for a Canadian ready-meal brand, featuring a dynamic product catalog and store locator integration.
projects.thescreamingchef.overview_descr: The Screaming Chef is a Canadian food brand offering refrigerated ready-to-eat meals that use innovative steam-cooking packaging technology. The website serves as the primary online presence for the brand, showcasing its product line, brand story, and commitment to quality and convenience.
projects.thescreamingchef.challenge_desc:
• Present multiple products with structured information.
  • Allow non-technical staff to easily manage content.
  • Provide a store locator for nearby retailers.
  • Implement pixel-perfect layouts from Adobe XD designs.
  • Ensure performance and scalability.
projects.thescreamingchef.solution_descr: I developed a fully custom WordPress theme from scratch, translating the design team's Adobe XD layouts into a responsive and pixel-perfect implementation. The CMS architecture was structured using Advanced Custom Fields Pro and custom post types to allow flexible and scalable content management.

A Google Maps API integration powers the store locator feature, enabling users to easily find nearby retailers carrying the brand's products. Contact inquiries are handled using Ninja Forms, providing a reliable communication channel between customers and the brand.
projects.thescreamingchef.features_descr:
• Fully custom WordPress theme development
  • Dynamic product management using Custom Post Types
  • Flexible content management with ACF Pro
  • Store locator powered by Google Maps API
  • Pixel-perfect implementation from Adobe XD designs
  • Contact forms using Ninja Forms
projects.thescreamingchef.role_descripti:
• Custom WordPress theme development
  • Front-end and back-end implementation
  • CMS architecture using ACF and custom post types
  • Google Maps API integration
  • Pixel-perfect development from design files
projects.eggmasters.short_description: Interactive WordPress contest platform developed for Egg Farmers of Ontario, featuring user photo submissions, restaurant discovery, and multilingual support.
projects.eggmasters.project_overview_des: Egg Masters is a promotional platform created for Egg Farmers of Ontario, supporting a recurring restaurant contest across Ontario where customers submit photos and reviews of egg-based dishes served by participating restaurants.
projects.eggmasters.overview_description: The contest existed prior to the development of this platform but had limited user engagement. After launching the new website and submission system, participation increased by approximately 4,900%, transforming the campaign into a highly engaging community-driven experience. The platform also supports multilingual content in English and French, ensuring accessibility for Canada's bilingual audience.
projects.eggmasters.challenge_descriptio:
• Enable reliable photo uploads directly from mobile devices.
  • Ensure compatibility across iOS and Android browsers.
  • Optimize large mobile images before storing them.
  • Create a moderation workflow for submitted content.
  • Provide an interactive map with participating restaurants and directions.
  • Support multilingual content in English and French.
  • Increase user participation and engagement in the contest.
projects.eggmasters.solution_description: I developed a custom WordPress platform tailored specifically for the contest workflow and user-generated content. Visitors can upload photos of their dishes along with short reviews, which are placed into a moderation queue before being approved and displayed in the public gallery feed.

Since most users access the platform through smartphones, the interface was built with a mobile-first approach using Tailwind CSS. Uploaded images are optimized before storage to prevent large mobile photos from negatively affecting performance.

The platform also integrates the Google Maps API to display participating restaurants and provide directions. Social sharing features help extend the campaign's reach, encouraging users to share their entries across social networks.
projects.eggmasters.key_features_descrip:
• Mobile-first photo upload system
  • User-generated gallery with moderation workflow
  • Automatic image optimization for large mobile photos
  • Interactive restaurant map powered by Google Maps API
  • Social sharing and engagement features
  • Multilingual support (English and French)
  • Contest platform that increased participation by ~4,900%
projects.eggmasters.my_role_description:
• Custom WordPress platform development
  • Architecture for user-generated content submission and moderation
  • Mobile-first front-end development using Tailwind CSS
  • Image optimization pipeline for uploaded photos
  • Google Maps API integration for restaurant locations
  • Implementation of multilingual support
projects.yestv.short_description: Custom WordPress website developed for a Canadian television network, featuring dynamic programming schedules powered by an external API.
projects.yestv.overview_description: YesTV is a Canadian television network broadcasting family-friendly and faith-based programming across Canada. The website acts as the network’s central digital platform, providing viewers with information about shows, schedules, and network initiatives.
projects.yestv.overview_description_2: The platform was developed using WordPress with a custom theme, designed to provide flexible content management while integrating real-time programming information through an external API.
projects.yestv.challenge_description:
• Integrate daily programming schedules from an external API.
  • Allow editors to manage diverse page layouts easily.
  • Create reusable content components for consistent design.
  • Optimize site performance and search engine visibility.
  • Support frequent content updates for shows and network information.
projects.yestv.solution_description: I developed a custom WordPress theme built around reusable content components and a modular architecture. Using Advanced Custom Fields, I implemented flexible custom blocks that allow editors to easily construct pages while maintaining consistent layouts and styling.
projects.yestv.solution_description_2: The daily programming schedule is retrieved through an external API, ensuring accurate and automatically updated broadcast information without requiring manual updates in the CMS.
projects.yestv.solution_description_3: The site was also optimized for fast performance and SEO-friendly markup, helping improve discoverability of shows and network content.
projects.yestv.key_features_description:
• Custom WordPress theme development
  • API-powered daily programming schedule
  • Reusable content blocks using ACF
  • Flexible CMS architecture for editorial teams
  • Performance optimization
  • SEO-focused development
projects.yestv.my_role_description:
• Custom WordPress theme development
  • API integration for programming schedules
  • Development of reusable content blocks with ACF
  • Front-end implementation using Bootstrap
  • Performance and SEO optimization
projects.sungro.short_description: Large-scale WordPress multisite platform developed for Sun Gro Horticulture, supporting multiple brands and domains. Features a shared component system, multilingual support, and API-driven product catalogs.
projects.sungro.project_overview_descrip: Sun Gro Horticulture is a leading North American provider of growing media and soil products used by commercial growers and gardening enthusiasts. The company manages multiple brands, each with its own digital presence and product catalog.

To support this ecosystem, the platform was built as a WordPress multisite network allowing multiple brand websites to share a unified architecture while maintaining independent domains and content management.
projects.sungro.challenge_description:
• Migrate multiple brand websites into a unified platform.
  • Support five different domains within a single multisite network.
  • Integrate brand-specific product catalogs through an API.
  • Maintain consistent design across brands using shared templates.
  • Implement multilingual support.
  • Deliver the project within a short migration timeline.
projects.sungro.solution_description: The platform was implemented using WordPress Multisite, allowing each brand to operate as an independent website while sharing a centralized codebase and component system.
projects.sungro.solution_description_2: Reusable content components were developed using ACF Pro custom blocks, enabling consistent layouts while providing editorial flexibility.
projects.sungro.solution_description_3: Product catalogs are dynamically loaded through a REST API integration, ensuring that each brand displays the appropriate products based on the domain being accessed. Additional integrations include Google Maps and extended form functionality using custom Ninja Forms hooks.
projects.sungro.key_features_description:
• WordPress multisite architecture
  • Multi-domain configuration across five brand websites
  • Reusable component system using ACF blocks
  • API-driven product catalogs
  • Multilingual support
  • Google Maps integration
  • Extended Ninja Forms functionality with custom hooks
projects.sungro.my_role_description:
• Multisite platform implementation
  • Reusable component architecture using ACF blocks
  • REST API integration for product catalogs
  • Multilingual implementation
  • Integration of Google Maps and custom Ninja Forms hooks
  • Collaboration in a large-scale migration project
projects.odoughs.short_description: Custom Shopify implementation supporting multi-country e-commerce for the United States and Canada. Built with Liquid templates and market-specific logic for localized products and multilingual content.
projects.odoughs.description_1: O’Doughs is a North American brand specializing in gluten-free baked goods, offering bagels, buns, and bakery products designed for customers seeking allergen-friendly and gluten-free options.
projects.odoughs.description_2: The website serves as the brand’s primary e-commerce platform, supporting customers in both the United States and Canada. The storefront was extended to support market-specific functionality while maintaining a consistent shopping experience across regions.
projects.odoughs.challenge_description:
• Support separate product catalogs for U.S. and Canadian markets.
  • Implement market-specific functionality within a single Shopify theme.
  • Provide multilingual content across the storefront.
  • Dynamically load products depending on the active market.
  • Ensure a consistent user experience across both countries.
projects.odoughs.solution_description: The Shopify theme was extended using Liquid, JSON templates, and JavaScript to support the platform’s multi-market requirements.
projects.odoughs.solution_description_2: Custom logic was implemented to detect the active market and load the appropriate product catalog and functionality for either the United States or Canada. This ensured that users see the correct products and localized content depending on their location.
projects.odoughs.solution_description_3: Multilingual support was also integrated into the storefront, enabling the platform to serve content in multiple languages while maintaining consistent navigation and product presentation.
projects.odoughs.solution_description_4: The result is a scalable Shopify storefront capable of supporting multiple regions and localized customer experiences within a single theme architecture.
projects.odoughs.key_features_descriptio:
• Multi-market Shopify storefront for U.S. and Canadian customers
  • Market-specific product catalog handling
  • Multilingual storefront support
  • Custom Liquid theme development
  • Dynamic product loading based on market
  • Performance-optimized theme architecture
projects.odoughs.my_role_description:
• Shopify theme customization and feature development
  • Implementation of market-specific functionality
  • Dynamic product loading for U.S. and Canadian markets
  • Multilingual storefront implementation
  • Front-end development using Liquid and JavaScript
projects.sakurastorenicaragua.short_desc: Personal project where I designed and built a headless WooCommerce architecture using GraphQL, AI-powered product assistance, and automation workflows.
projects.sakurastorenicaragua.descriptio: Sakura Store Nicaragua began as a small Facebook-based shop selling anime plushies and merchandise. My wife originally started the store as a hobby about two years ago, managing a small catalog of roughly 20 products through a Facebook fan page.
As the store gradually grew to nearly 300 products, managing inventory, product information, and customer inquiries through social media alone became increasingly complicated.

To support the continued growth of the business and simplify product management, I decided to build a dedicated e-commerce platform for the store. I began developing the site during the December 2025 holidays using a modern headless commerce architecture.
projects.sakurastorenicaragua.challenge_:
• Transition from a Facebook-only store to a scalable platform.
  • Manage a growing catalog approaching 300 products.
  • Create an architecture ready for AI and automation.
  • Provide efficient product search and information retrieval.
  • Integrate marketing channels such as Facebook and WhatsApp.
projects.sakurastorenicaragua.solution_d: The platform uses a headless WooCommerce architecture where WordPress acts as the commerce backend while a Slim 4 PHP application serves the frontend.
GraphQL is used instead of the standard WordPress REST API, allowing the frontend application to efficiently retrieve products, users, pages, and orders from the WooCommerce backend.
projects.sakurastorenicaragua.ai_integra: An experimental AI product assistant powered by WooCommerce MCP allows customers to ask questions about products such as models, colors, availability, and pricing. The long-term goal is to extend this system to assist customers throughout the purchasing process.
projects.sakurastorenicaragua.automation:
• Automated Facebook product posting using n8n
  • WhatsApp notifications for new orders
  • Workflow automation connecting store services
projects.sakurastorenicaragua.developmen: Currently in active development during weekends and free time. The first public version is planned for release in May 2026.
projects.azwoundsolutions.short_descript: This project focused on performance optimization and technical improvements for an existing WordPress site rather than building a new one from scratch.
projects.azwoundsolutions.description_1: The website was built using WordPress with the Divi Builder and a child theme, but it was experiencing significant performance and technical SEO issues. Initial audits showed PageSpeed scores below 50%, while accessibility and SEO metrics were below 60%, negatively impacting both user experience and search visibility.
projects.azwoundsolutions.description_2: After taking ownership of the project, I performed a full technical audit using tools such as Google PageSpeed Insights, Ahrefs, and Google Search Console to identify the primary performance bottlenecks and SEO issues.
projects.azwoundsolutions.key_descriptio:
• Implemented server-level and WordPress caching to improve load times.
  • Optimized JavaScript and CSS delivery by combining and minifying files.
  • Identified and fixed broken links across the site.
  • Added missing image titles and metadata to improve accessibility and SEO.
  • Resolved pages that were not properly connected through internal linking.
  • Performed additional technical SEO improvements identified through Ahrefs and Search Console audits.
projects.azwoundsolutions.results_descri: Following these optimizations, the website achieved:
projects.azwoundsolutions.results_list:
• 96+ scores across PageSpeed metrics
  • Significant improvements in accessibility, SEO, and performance
  • Green performance indicators in both Ahrefs and Google PageSpeed Insights
projects.azwoundsolutions.results_descri: These improvements resulted in a faster, more accessible, and SEO-friendly website, providing a better user experience while improving the site's search performance.
